content.short: Nina is a decentralized Solana protocol for publishing, streaming, and purchasing music.
content.description: Nina is a decentralized music protocol on Solana that enables artists to publish, stream, and sell their music directly to listeners. Releases appear as tokenized assets available for streaming and purchase, with quantities and prices set by the artists themselves. Artists pay a small upload fee to cover the permanent storage of their work. Nina pays artists 100% of primary sales and a share of secondary-market sales, chosen by the artist.
